style: flat kawaii chibi 2D animation, thick clean outlines, pastel palette, cel shading, consistent with the references.
stage: TV debate studio in flat kawaii chibi Chiikawa anime style: thick clean dark outlines, soft pastel colors, flat cel shading. Deep navy-blue backdrop with subtle sparkle pattern, warm spotlights. Two wooden lecterns with microphones (rabbit LEFT, otter RIGHT), a small moderator desk at CENTER between them, and a big screen above showing a rising line chart labeled 'INFLATION'.

characters.identity_desc: RABBIT (cream-white rabbit, tall ears with pink insides, RED necktie, navy suit)
characters.voice_desc: an excited squeaky high-pitched cartoon voice with chaotic energy

characters.identity_desc: OTTER (beige spiky-fur sea otter, star-shaped scar over LEFT eye, BLUE necktie, navy suit)
characters.voice_desc: a calm LOW-pitched gruff masculine cartoon voice, mature and weary — clearly DEEPER than a squeaky voice

characters.identity_desc: CAT (white cat, blue-gray top-half head marking, GRAY vest, cue cards)
characters.voice_desc: a soft gentle boyish cartoon voice, mild and polite, medium pitch — NOT squeaky, NOT deep

shots.speaker: usagi
shots.camera: Medium close-up on the LEFT lectern, straight-on TV framing
shots.action: The rabbit spreads both paws wide bragging, pinches thumb and finger together making a circle gesture, stumbles on the number and re-opens the paw, then taps its own chest twice proudly
shots.line: 那些汉堡，白宫历史上最好的汉堡，所有人都这么说。九百……不对，一千，一千多个，全是我自己掏的钱。
shots.start_state: The rabbit stands behind the LEFT lectern facing camera, both paws resting on the lectern edge, mouth just opening; the INFLATION chart glows on the big screen behind

shots.speaker: usagi
shots.camera: Close-up on the rabbit at the LEFT lectern leaning toward the right
shots.action: The rabbit drags one finger down its cheek miming a tear with an earnest face, then snaps to pointing straight at the opponent, eyebrows pressed down, ending frozen mid-point
shots.line: 那些冠军，最强壮的人，吃到哭了。真的哭了。乔，你在白宫请过谁？说一个名字。

shots.speaker: hachi
shots.camera: Medium shot of the center moderator desk
shots.action: The cat moderator flips a cue card, puts it down wearily, raises one paw in resignation; strained polite smile
shots.line: 两位，我们本来在聊通货膨胀……好吧，那你说说你的汉堡。

shots.speaker: racco
shots.camera: Medium close-up on the RIGHT lectern
shots.action: The otter holds up one finger, pauses on the name and corrects himself with a small headshake, pats the lectern softly on '一张桌子', then turns palm-up toward the audience on the egg-price line, weary frown
shots.line: 说一个？行。斯克兰顿，一个消防员，马克……不对，麦克。他跟我坐一张桌子吃的，没哭。他就问了我一句——鸡蛋，怎么涨成这样。

shots.speaker: hachi
shots.camera: Medium shot of the center moderator desk
shots.action: The cat points a paw up at the INFLATION screen, looks around, gets no reaction, slumps back in the chair with flat resigned eyes
shots.line: 我提醒一句，通胀数据还在大屏上挂着——没人看是吧，行。

shots.speaker: usagi
shots.camera: Close-up on the rabbit at the LEFT lectern
shots.action: The rabbit cups a paw to its ear in mock confusion swaying left then right on the two names, then slaps its palm flat on the lectern on the last word, mouth wide in a triumphant shout
shots.line: 马克还是麦克？一张桌子吃的饭，名字都记不住？悲哀！

shots.speaker: hachi
shots.camera: Medium shot of the center moderator desk
shots.action: The cat glances toward an off-screen control booth, makes a helpless two-finger 'two more rounds' gesture at the camera, ears drooping
shots.line: 导播问我们要不要切广告。我说再给两轮，你们把汉堡这事说完。

shots.speaker: racco
shots.camera: Medium close-up on the RIGHT lectern
shots.action: The otter presses a paw down flat on the lectern on the name confirmation, raises one finger then folds it back mid-sentence, then slowly pushes a half-closed fist toward the opponent and holds it in the air
shots.line: 麦克。是麦克。得了吧，你那一千个……九百个汉堡，往桌上一摆就完了？你挨着哪一个坐下吃的？

shots.speaker: hachi
shots.camera: Medium shot of the center moderator desk
shots.action: The cat rubs its temples with both paws, then holds up one stern finger
shots.line: 最后一轮。说完汉堡，谁也别想再点别的菜。

shots.speaker: usagi
shots.camera: Medium shot of the LEFT lectern with the silver platter piled with cartoon hamburgers on top
shots.action: The rabbit pats the center of the lectern claiming the head seat, then raises a paw high above its own head marking someone tall, freezes mid-gesture fumbling the name with fingers flexing
shots.line: 我坐哪儿？主位，正中间。我旁边就是那个四分卫，克莱姆森的，特雷……德肖恩？反正是个大个子，两百三十磅。

shots.speaker: usagi
shots.camera: Close-up on the rabbit at the LEFT lectern
shots.action: The rabbit thrusts four spread fingers toward the opponent, jabs them forward again on the repeat, then flings the last word out toward the audience with its chin raised
shots.line: 他一个人吃了四十个，全熟的，多加番茄酱。四十个，乔。

shots.speaker: hachi
shots.camera: Quick medium shot of the center moderator desk
shots.action: The cat lifts a paw and looks at an imaginary wristwatch, deadpan

shots.speaker: racco
shots.camera: Close-up on the otter at the RIGHT lectern
shots.action: The otter extends one finger pointing slightly left, then adds a second finger pointing slightly right, keeps both fingers hanging in the air, gaze locked forward, absolutely still afterward

shots.speaker: hachi
shots.camera: Wide establishing shot of the full stage, all three characters visible
shots.action: The cat moderator stands up, draws a hard horizontal stop-line in the air with a paw, walks to the center point between the two lecterns facing the audience; the rabbit and otter keep glaring at each other
shots.line: 到点了，两位。话筒还给导播——广告回来是天气预报。晚安。

notes: 台词取自已过盲审的中文汉堡辩论剧本；分镜按15s上限拆分。
